subtitle: Check a document against the issuer's record. Upload a PDF, or a photo or scan of a printed copy. Supported: {document_types}.

messages.case_id_required: A case or application ID is required.
messages.request_unreadable: The request could not be read.
messages.field_unreadable: Could not read {field} from the document.
messages.qr_mismatch: QR code number differs from the printed certificate number.
messages.not_found: Issuer has no record of this certificate number.
messages.field_mismatch: {field} on the document does not match the issuer record.
messages.all_match: All printed fields match the issuer record.
messages.unconnected: No issuer is connected for this document type.
messages.not_configured: No API key is configured for this issuer. Run issuer_service/setup_keys.py.
messages.key_rejected: The issuer rejected Pramanik's API key (or the key is not allowed for this issuer).
messages.rate_limited: The issuer is limiting requests. Try again shortly.
messages.registry_unavailable: The issuer is reachable but its registry could not be read.
messages.bad_response: The issuer sent a response Pramanik could not read.
messages.insecure_transport: The issuer address uses plain HTTP. Use HTTPS (plain HTTP is only allowed for localhost).
messages.http_error: The issuer returned an unexpected error ({detail}).
messages.unsupported_file: Upload a PDF, or a JPG, PNG or WebP photo or scan of the document.
messages.pdf_unreadable: This PDF could not be opened. It may be damaged or password-protected.
messages.all_match_with_warnings: All printed fields match the issuer record, with points to review.
messages.integrity_concerns: The document matches the issuer record, but other checks raise integrity concerns. Review before accepting.
messages.scan_invalid_image: The image file could not be read. Take a new photo or scan.
messages.scan_low_resolution: The image is too small ({w}x{h}). Hold the camera closer or scan at a higher resolution.
messages.scan_blur: The image is too blurry to read. Hold the camera steady and refocus.
messages.scan_dark: The image is too dark to read. Improve the lighting and take it again.
messages.scan_glare: The image is washed out or has glare. Avoid flash reflections and take it again.
messages.scan_quality_ok: Image quality is good enough to read.
messages.scan_rectified: The page was found and straightened.
messages.scan_rectify_fallback: No page outline found; the whole image was used.
messages.scan_ocr_unavailable: Reading photos and scans is not available on this server (the OCR engine, Tesseract, is not installed).
messages.scan_unreadable: Very little text could be read from this image.
messages.scan_rescan_hint: Place the whole page flat and in focus, in even light, with the QR code in frame, and try again.
messages.scan_low_confidence: {field} could only be read with low confidence ({conf}%).
messages.scan_field_missing: {field} could not be found in the image.
messages.scan_read_caveat: These values were read from an image. If the printed text looks different, rescan before acting.
messages.qr_none: No QR code could be read on this image.
messages.qr_plain: QR code read; it holds a certificate number.
messages.signed_qr_valid: The QR is signed by the issuer and its signature is valid (key {kid}).
messages.qr_sig_malformed: The QR looks like a signed token but is damaged or malformed.
messages.qr_sig_unknown_key: The QR is signed with a key Pramanik does not recognise for this issuer.
messages.qr_sig_key_revoked: The QR is signed with a key the issuer has revoked.
messages.qr_sig_bad_signature: The QR's signature does not verify. The QR may have been altered or forged.
messages.qr_sig_no_keys: No issuer signing keys are configured, so the QR signature could not be checked.
messages.signed_field_mismatch: {field} on the document differs from the issuer-signed QR.
messages.signed_type_mismatch: The issuer-signed QR is for a different type of document.
messages.link_insecure: The document contains an insecure (http) link: {url}
messages.link_shortener: The document contains a shortened link ({host}); official certificates link to official domains.
messages.link_lookalike: The document contains a link that imitates an official domain ({host}).
messages.link_unknown: The document links to an unverified domain: {host}
messages.reuse_other_cases: This certificate has already been checked in {count} other case(s).
messages.reuse_many: This certificate has been presented in {count} other cases, which is unusual.
messages.stamp_reuse: The stamp area is identical to one on a different certificate checked earlier.
messages.risk_ocr: Read from an image, which is less reliable than a text PDF.
messages.risk_low_confidence: Some text was read with low confidence ({conf}%).
messages.risk_signature_valid: The QR carries a valid issuer signature.
messages.issuer_cached: The issuer's answer was reused from {minutes} minute(s) ago. Tick "Ask the issuer again" for a live check.
messages.visual_mismatch: {field} in the PDF's text differs from what is shown on the page.
messages.visual_unconfirmed: Some values could not be confirmed against the visible page.
messages.visual_confirmed: The PDF's text matches what is visible on the page.
messages.pdf_conflicting_text: The PDF contains conflicting values for {field}; it may have been edited.
messages.auth_password_length: Use a password of {min} to {max} characters.
messages.auth_email_taken: An account with this e-mail already exists. Log in instead.
messages.auth_too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
messages.auth_signup_closed: Sign-up is closed. Ask an administrator for an account.
messages.auth_signup_code: That sign-up code is not correct.
messages.auth_officer_id_invalid: An officer ID uses letters, digits and . _ - / (2 to 63 characters).
messages.auth_officer_id_taken: That officer ID already belongs to another account.
messages.auth_field_too_long: One of the fields is too long.
messages.auth_forbidden_origin: Request blocked: it did not come from this site.
